entries.name: Tingting's Wares
entries.content: Tingting's Wares is an online store run by Tingting where she sells various things she's built and invented in her spare time. Most of these inventions are essentially more advanced versions of common household appliances, but she has put some wackier inventions for sale every now and then.

entries.name: Project Shota World
